verdict.reasoning: Rendered page 931 (printed 907) at 300 dpi. In the PDF's right column, sub-entries are visibly indented under their headwords: REPLACE statement 37 (continuing Compiler directing statement / COPY statement from the left column), AND/NOT/OR operator 164 under Complex conditions, ADD/DIVIDE/MULTIPLY/SUBTRACT under Composite of operands, USAGE clause 405 under COMPUTATIONAL phrase, OBJECT-COMPUTER/SOURCE-COMPUTER paragraph under Computer-name, Abbreviated combined relation condition ... Switch-status condition under Condition 152, EVALUATE statement 493 under Conditional expression, Definition 114 under Conditional variable, Qualified with subscripts ... Switch status under Condition-name. The markdown renders every right-column line with the same 3-space prefix and no   marker (unlike the left column, which uses   for sub-entries), so headwords and sub-entries sit at one level and the hierarchy is lost; e.g. 'USAGE clause 405' and 'EVALUATE statement 493' read as top-level entries. The claim's quotes are accurate (markdown quote abbreviated with '...'). Content is informative index, so structural, not normative.
